_observations.multiple_matches: Not deliberately authored. The matcher will surface multiple_matches if the leading 30 normalized chars of a quote appear in 2+ sentences. As of this writing no real candidate group has produced one in the live API; if one shows up later, add it explicitly here rather than synthesizing one.
_observations.题目版_groups_unsupported: 2026 浙江卷（1月）题目版 reading groups (e.g. g-6e87fbdf, g-76da9842) are NOT included because their questions store empty options arrays in the live API; the selector correctly rejects them with reason='unsupported-question-type'. They will become eligible once their 答案版 counterparts land.
